trigger.method: Create a new GitHub issue with the OpenCode label and the request marker in the body
trigger.effect: The official opencode.yml resolves the selected branch through the GitHub branches API and passes the resolved full target SHA to the pinned reusable workflow

unsupported_actions: Resume Issue #17 while expecting a different source SHA
Replace Issue #17 preview through an undocumented API
verification_after_trigger: Read the new issue API response and workflow run
Confirm resolved target_ref equals the candidate branch
Confirm resolved target_sha equals the candidate SHA
Confirm new preview is separate from Issue #17
Verify loaded game resource hashes before continuing development
rollback: Close or stop the new issue/session and retain Issue #17, its preview, checkpoint and resume branch unchanged. The candidate branch remains an immutable recovery source.
